v1.1.0 - Church profile, sermon series threading, scripture context, platform-specific social posts, image generation prompts, Telegram delivery hook.

Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches "ministry-weekly" skill to streamline church communications.
- Generates a full weekly content package from a single Sunday briefing: bulletin draft, three social media posts, and a ready-to-send weekly email.
- Adapts to input style and fills gaps with brief follow-up or sensible assumptions, noting any key guesses for user review.
- Designed for clarity, warmth, and flexibility across a range of church cultures.
